ground-skill-dig.name: Dig
ground-skill-dig.description: New skill: burrows up to strike a foe 2 hexes away, no line of sight needed.

ground-skill-bonemerang.name: Bonemerang
ground-skill-bonemerang.description: New skill: throws a bone at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 55).

ground-skill-magnitude.name: Magnitude
ground-skill-magnitude.description: New skill: a quake hits every foe within 2 hexes of it (Power 80).

ground-arena-trap.name: Arena Trap
ground-arena-trap.description: Foes engaged with it always draw its free strike when leaving; free strikes +30%.

ground-unshakable.name: Unshakable
ground-unshakable.description: Capstone. Ground moves deal 25% more damage; cannot be Slowed or Paralyzed.

ground-dug-in.name: Dug In
ground-dug-in.description: Heals 5% of its max HP each turn while engaged with a foe; +1 Defense.

ground-skill-earthquake.name: Earthquake
ground-skill-earthquake.description: New Bond skill: a quake hits every foe within 3 hexes of it (Power 90).
